g.text: Charter, 4 players. Warm-started by copying an older rule-based bot, then trained against itself and an evolved rival*.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: * Evolved by program synthesis [read: Claude keeps rewriting the bot and we keep whatever wins].

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: The bot it copied is an older rule-based bot. The bot at our tables today is stronger: our best checkpoint wins 24% against it (PR #31).

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: Bot games: 800 per point on Island and Not Catan, with 95% intervals.
